title: Nilikuwa mwanachama wa Anytime Fitness kwa miezi miwili tu
label: Anytime Fitness

text.I was once a member of a gym called Anyt: Niliwahi kuwa mwanachama wa ukumbi wa mazoezi uitwao Anytime Fitness.
Hata hivyo, niliacha baada ya miezi miwili tu.
text.There was a campaign where you could joi: Kulikuwa na ofa ya kujiunga kwa takriban yen 500, nami nilitaka kujaribu.
text.The Anytime Fitness I went to was in the: Anytime Fitness niliyokuwa nikihudhuria ilikuwa eneo la Sakae, Nagoya.
text.In front of the entrance, there was Nago: Mbele ya mlango kulikuwa na mchoro mzuri wa ubao wenye mandhari ya Nagoya.
text.🖍 The \"Welcome to Nagoya\" chalkboard a: 🖍 Mchoro wa ubao ulioandikwa “Welcome to Nagoya”
text.Anytime Fitness is a foreign company, an: Anytime Fitness ni kampuni ya kigeni, na vituo vyake vipo karibu kila mahali duniani, sivyo?
text.It seems members can enter any of its gy: Inaonekana wanachama wanaweza kuingia katika kituo chake chochote duniani.
text.This \"it is all over the world\" part s: Kilichonishangaza zaidi ni kwamba ipo kote duniani.
Namna ya kuingia pia ilikuwa ya kuvutia.
text.On an iPhone, you press the power button: Kwenye iPhone, unabonyeza kitufe cha pembeni mara mbili ili kulipa kwa kadi ya mkopo, sivyo?
text.With the same system, I could enter usin: Kwa mfumo huohuo, ningeweza kuingia kwa kutumia kipengele cha Wallet cha iPhone.
text.What I liked was that the people exercis: Nilipenda kwamba watu waliokuwa wakifanya mazoezi walikuwa na umri mkubwa zaidi.
text.Probably, people under 18 cannot join ye: Huenda walio chini ya miaka 18 bado hawawezi kujiunga.
text.Actually, at that time, I was also a mem: Kwa kweli, wakati huo pia nilikuwa mwanachama wa ukumbi mwingine wa mazoezi.
text.That gym had a lounge-like space you cou: Ukumbi huo ulikuwa na sehemu kama sebule iliyotumiwa kwa uhuru, ambamo wanafunzi wa shule ya upili walisoma mara nyingi.
text.I did not really like seeing high school: Sikupenda sana kuwaona wanafunzi wa shule ya kati na upili wakifanya mazoezi au kusoma kwa nguvu nyingi hivyo.
text.I ended up feeling, \"They are only in h: Nilijikuta nikifikiria, “Wanajitahidi sana ilhali bado wako shule ya upili—ajabu kweli,” na hilo lilinivuruga sana.
text.But at Anytime Fitness, you can only joi: Lakini Anytime Fitness, ni watu wenye miaka 18 au zaidi tu wanaoweza kujiunga, kwa hiyo kuna watu wazima wengi.
text.Inside the gym was quiet too, in a good: Ndani ya ukumbi pia kulikuwa na utulivu mzuri.
Niliupenda ukumbi huu kwa kiasi kikubwa.
text.The reason I quit is simple: I realized: Sababu ya kuacha ni rahisi: nilitambua kuwa kutembea nje huniburudisha zaidi.
text.I felt that walking outside refreshes me: Nilihisi kwamba kutembea nje huniburudisha zaidi kuliko kufanya mazoezi ukumbini.
text.Just walking outside, I can exercise and: Kwa kutembea nje tu, nafanya mazoezi na kujisikia vizuri.
Kwa hiyo niliacha kwenda kwenye ukumbi wa ndani.
text.But I think you should join a gym especi: Hata hivyo, nafikiri ni vizuri kujiunga na ukumbi wa mazoezi hasa wakati wa baridi.
text.I think joining a gym in winter is a ver: Nafikiri kujiunga na ukumbi wakati wa baridi ni chaguo zuri sana.
text.I leave the gym after 5 minutes, but I c: Naondoka gym baada ya dakika 5, lakini naweza kuruka dakika 45 kwenye gym ya trampolini
text.The big whiteboard I regret buying sold: Ubao mkubwa najuta kuununua ukiuzwa kwa Jimoty kwa 4,000 yen
